_why: KURAL 29, refusal 5: a gate that always blocks gets switched off by a human, and then there is
no gate. This repository has a long-standing, DOCUMENTED red baseline. A pre-push hook that
blocks on it would be turned off within a day, so the hook blocks on NEW failures only.
A baseline is a RATCHET, never a permit. `scripts/pre-push-gate.mjs` refuses when actual >
allowed, and PRINTS A DEMAND when actual < allowed: lower the number in the same commit that
earned it. A baseline that is never lowered has stopped measuring and started excusing.
Every entry needs `why` and `since`. An entry with neither is an unexplained exemption, which is
the shape this project has repeatedly found hiding a real defect.

packages/gate.why: No exemption. Ratcheted 2 -> 1 -> 0 on 2026-08-03 as ADR-0006-A parts A and B landed (01dc642, 0e0d6a8). The entry is kept at zero rather than deleted so that the ratchet's history stays readable and a future red cannot be quietly re-baselined without editing a number someone has to justify.
packages/gate.closesWhen: n/a — already zero. Raising this number requires a `why` and a `since`, and a reviewer who accepts them.
